title: Cities Skylines | Franklin Episode 7: Liberalism
description:
Not much urbanism in this episode, but a lot of political economy which will illuminate some of the decisions and policies which will come later in the series.

About the August 21 Prison Strike: https://incarceratedworkers.org/campaigns/prison-strike-2018

Philosophy Tube on liberalism: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VlLgvSduugI


The title music is Beethoven's Symphony no. 5 in Cm, Op. 67 - IV. Allegro, performed by the Davis High School Symphony Orchestra. It is available here: https://musopen.org/music/2567-symphony-no-5-in-cm-op-67/

The cinematics music is Felix Mendelssohn's The Hebrides (Die Hebriden), Op. 26, performed by the Musopen Symphony. It is available here: https://musopen.org/music/306-the-hebrides-fingals-cave-op-26/
